shortDescription: The Dow Jones Index dropped 322 points or 0.61 percent on Tuesday to close at 52099 points.Losses were led by Nike (-2.35%), Alphabet (-2.28%) and Amazon (-2.00%).Offsetting the fall, top gainers were Chevron (2.53%), 3M (1.75%) and JPMorgan (1.11%).

children: The Dow Jones Index dropped 322 points or 0.61 percent on Tuesday to close at 52099 points.
Losses were led by Nike (-2.35%), Alphabet (-2.28%) and Amazon (-2.00%).

title: The Dow Jones Index Closes 0.61% Lower
